courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的隧道與地下設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring tunnels and underground works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 隧道管片預鑄與養護
related.transfer: 可遷移「壓縮量與溝槽幾何」與「黏貼與表面相容」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；隧道管片預鑄與養護的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Compression and groove geometry" and "Bonding and surface compatibility" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Tunnel-segment precasting and curing must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦把止水墊壓縮、接縫偏移與長期鬆弛連到可驗證的水密性；隧道管片預鑄與養護則以把環片永久受力、製造品質與暫態施工荷載連成完整驗證鏈為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on connect gasket compression, joint offset and long-term relaxation to verifiable watertightness; Tunnel-segment precasting and curing centres on connect permanent segment behavior, manufacturing quality and temporary construction loads, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「壓縮量與溝槽幾何」與「全環與局部荷載」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到隧道管片預鑄與養護，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「推進千斤頂局部承壓」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Compression and groove geometry” and “Ring and local load cases”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Tunnel-segment precasting and curing, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Local jack bearing", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 隧道管片接頭結構驗證
related.transfer: 可遷移「壓縮量與溝槽幾何」與「黏貼與表面相容」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；隧道管片接頭結構驗證的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Compression and groove geometry" and "Bonding and surface compatibility" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Structural verification of segment joints must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦把止水墊壓縮、接縫偏移與長期鬆弛連到可驗證的水密性；隧道管片接頭結構驗證則以用軸力彎矩、接觸張開與螺栓行為檢核環片接縫為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on connect gasket compression, joint offset and long-term relaxation to verifiable watertightness; Structural verification of segment joints centres on check segment joints through axial force, bending, contact opening and bolt behavior, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「壓縮量與溝槽幾何」與「軸力彎矩與偏心」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到隧道管片接頭結構驗證，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「循環載重與鬆弛」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Compression and groove geometry” and “Axial force bending and eccentricity”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Structural verification of segment joints, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Cyclic loading and relaxation", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 隧道管片防水墊圈安裝
history.text: 美國聯邦公路管理局於2009年發行公路隧道土建技術手冊，整理調查與土建工程的公開原理；瑞士官方介紹聖哥達基線隧道長57公里並於2016年投入營運，提供深埋長隧道的工程環境對照。Crossrail於2017年公開完工後地質縱剖面，提醒讀者鑽孔密度、偏離隧道位置與簡化斷層會限制推論。這些出版節點顯示把止水墊壓縮、接縫偏移與長期鬆弛連到可驗證的水密性需要把原始紀錄和模型分開保存；地標僅供工程環境比較，本課只重建公開原理。
history.textEn: FHWA issued its civil-elements road-tunnel manual in 2009, collecting public investigation and civil-engineering principles. Swiss government information records the 57 km Gotthard Base Tunnel entering operation in 2016, providing context for long deep tunnels. Crossrail published a post-construction geological section in 2017, explaining limitations from borehole density, offset and simplified faults. These publication milestones show why connect gasket compression, joint offset and long-term relaxation to verifiable watertightness requires original observations to be preserved separately from interpretations. Landmarks provide contextual comparisons only; this course reconstructs public principles.
